verdict.rationale: AutoGen explicitly documents GraphFlow-style "multi-agent workflows through a directed graph of agents" (autogen-docs-13) alongside selector- and round-robin-based team patterns (autogen-docs-11, autogen-docs-12, autogen-docs-2), which supports composing agents into explicit graphs. However, evidence does not detail branching/looping/parallel-step semantics in depth, nor provide hands-on confirmation of complex graph workflows beyond the doc summary line. Missing for 10: detailed documentation or examples of branching conditions, loop constructs, and parallel execution within the graph workflow, plus independent/community validation of these graph features.
